description: The garden on its slope with a gable roof over the house and a flat carport roof, read by an implementation of FS_energy that knows it: PV1, five 350 W modules flush on the house roof's south face - 5' up its 9:12 slope, so 4' in plan - and PV2, two racks of three on the carport at 3:12, each rack 3' deep projected once, 2' apart; one hybrid inverter serving both and a rapid-shutdown initiator. Valid, every corner clear of its face's setbacks, nothing reported; it derives each array's mount, pitch, modules, watts, area and footprint, the inverter's 3,850 W offered and the totals.
